info.title: Wealth Master API
info.description: Session authentication, MFA, owner-scoped accounts, ledger activity, native-currency net worth and spending by category for a selected calendar month or year. Exact expense/refund/net totals, inclusive category breakdowns and supporting activity; budgeting is deferred. Monthly expected income, expenses and transfers with reviewed suggestions, skips and atomic actual recording.

post.summary: Create transactions
post.description: Past and future transaction/value dates, including before account opening (years 1–9999). Current balances include all nondeleted transactions through the business date, including before account opening; value dates do not control balances. Active owned accounts required. Transfers require distinct accounts with matching currencies. Negative resulting balances allowed. Refunds reduce spending; transfers are excluded from income/spending. Transfer edits/deletions change both movements atomically.

get.summary: Calculate current net worth for the authenticated owner
get.description: One repeatable-read snapshot of opening balances plus all non-deleted ledger movements through the business date, including entries before account opening. Future-dated activity is excluded until its transaction date. Positive balances are assets; negative balances are liabilities. Includes archived accounts and investment cash, excludes future-opening accounts. Native currencies remain separate; no FX conversion or security valuation. Business date uses APP_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE. Read-only; no CSRF token required.

openingAmount.description: Exact decimal string. Credit-card amount must be non-negative.

balanceMeaning.description: BALANCE for non-card accounts. AMOUNT_OWED is stored negative; IN_CREDIT positive.

openingBalance.description: Exact signed opening balance, not a current valuation.

hasActivity.description: Locks financial setup and prevents deletion when history exists.

categoryId.description: Optional; omission/null means Uncategorized, including full-replacement PUT. Income uses INCOME; expenses/refunds use SPENDING.

assets.description: Exact decimal string; aggregate integer digits are not limited to input precision.

liabilities.description: Exact decimal string; aggregate integer digits are not limited to input precision.

name.description: Trimmed; unique case-insensitively within owner/type/parent, including archived categories.
Trimmed; unique case-insensitively within owner/type/parent, including archived categories.

hasActivity.description: Permanent ledger references, including deleted activity and previously selected parents.

expenses.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

refunds.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

netSpending.description: Exact decimal amount; no floating point rounding

uncategorized.description: Exact uncategorized net spending in this currency.

defaultCurrency.description: Explicitly selected ISO 4217 currency. Null until selected.
Supported ISO 4217 code; no inferred default.

ExpectedInput.description: Monthly only. Months use their first calendar day; lastMonth is inclusive. Dates use years 1–9999. Amount must be positive. Currency follows account. Transfers require distinct same-currency accounts and no category. Edits update historical months too.

ExpectedOccurrence.description: Version 0 denotes untouched reconciliation state. Differences are actual minus expected; null when no actual or currencies differ. Deleted, incompatible or out-of-schedule links need review. Future-dated confirmed links show SCHEDULED until their transaction date; these amounts remain outstanding and are excluded from completed/actual totals.

ExpectedTotals.description: Exact decimal strings. Skipped items excluded. Completed is expected amounts for compatible confirmed links; actual is their ledger amounts. Transfers remain separate.

ExpectedReconcile.description: Full replacement: null operationId unlinks, skipped true skips this month. Linking requires current operationVersion and matching type, currency and accounts; actual dates may be in any month. One transaction can satisfy one occurrence.

ExpectedRecordInput.description: Reviewed actual fields; accounts/type come from definition. Creates ledger activity and confirms association atomically. Date may be in any month, including before account opening, and must use years 1–9999. The occurrence stays in its selected month; spending uses the actual transaction date. Future months and dates are allowed; future links are scheduled until their date.
